title: The new sports centre
summary_es: La inauguración de un polideportivo. Sufijos básicos: -ive, -ly, -or, -ment y el prefijo un-.
text: Last Saturday I went to the opening of our town's new sports centre. The building is modern and very {{1}}, and there is a huge swimming pool. The staff are {{2}} and always ready to help. I tried the climbing wall for the first time. I was a bit nervous, but the {{3}} explained everything {{4}}. To my {{5}}, I reached the top! The only problem is the price: it is quite expensive, which is {{6}} for students.

gaps.explanation_es: Tras «very» va un adjetivo: attract → attractive.
Aunque acaba en -ly, «friendly» es un adjetivo (simpático, amable).
Hace falta la persona que enseña: instruct → instructor (con -or, no -er).
Describe cómo explicó: adverbio de modo, adjetivo + -ly.
«To my amazement» = para mi asombro. Tras el posesivo va un nombre: verbo + -ment.
El sentido es negativo (es caro para los estudiantes): prefijo un-.
